{{Quote|The classic! A grilled-to-perfection patty topped with all the fixin's&mdash;a slice of Gonzo yellow cheese, Revwien lettuce, topato slices, grilled Ojomian onions and B'omarr-style pickles.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Coruscant slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Revwien lettuce''' was a type of [[Lettuce/Legends|lettuce]] used in the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], which was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The lettuce was used as an ingredient in a number of dishes<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> Such meals included Jettster's [[Coruscant slider]], a [[slider]] inspired by his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]; his [[Shawda Clubb sandwich|Shawda Club]] and [[Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich]]es; and the [[Interstellar garden salad]]. The lettuce used in the last was grown in [[VegSatellite]]s [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Coruscant. It shared its name with the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwiens]],<ref name="Menu" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[Revyia]].<ref name="gg12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have a fondness for abandoned concepts, hence the inclusion of the donut droid as well as references to Revwiens, Adarians, apple slugs and even Kenner's Mongo Beefhead Tribesman.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Revwien lettuce is mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Menu" /> Walker mentioned Revwiens in the article due to his fondness for abandoned concepts;<ref name="Blog" /> the Revwiens were intended to appear in<ref name="Revwien">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film,<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], but the complexity of their costume forced the idea to be scrapped.<ref name="Revwien" />
